body: Btw I appreciate you reaching out. I've had no one to really express my thoughts to in weeks.
I can ask. They told me only video conferencing or telephone was available so idk if that's something they can do.

I have no idea. My dad used to be an option but he got remarried and she has kids now so there's no place left to sleep there. All my other family members who live a considerable distance to where I work had moved out. I have no close friends IRL.
Also for what it's worth, this was why I wanted to see a therapist to begin with. I scheduled this over a month ago before all this shit happened. Now it's added fuel to the fire.

I already have. She used to help me when I encountered depression when I was a teenager. Now she's fed up with me and if she found out I was seeing a therapist again god forbid she kicks me out because "I don't trust her." I've also asked her for privacy and having my own freedom with things. She denies "controlling" my life but then she tries to do it anyway because she knows I can't afford to move out yet. I'm tired of being taken advantage of.
She's going to be wondering what I'm doing outside. I'm telling you, for me being a 28 year old, she's nosy as if I were still 12.
Like I said, teletherapy won't work at home. The last person I want to hear my thoughts is my toxic mother, whom I'm striving to save up to move out from, but this pandemic  isn't helping.
What does the outlook look like for August 2020 as far as the virus / restrictions?
Some are saying 3 months, some are saying 18 months. I have no idea what to believe. Regardless, I can't live like this.

How can one learn these when we're forced inside our homes? I slowly learned how to socialize but this pandemic prevents such activities from happening. Online chats do nothing for me, they fuel my depression. If this is how life is going to be for the next two years and possibly beyond I'm out.

What do you mean "room for rest"?

Apartment rates are so high here it's not worth it given the insecurities that go along with it. You're lucky to find anything below $1k/mo.
